title: ETH hourly volatility periodicity
claim: UTC-hour indicators improve next-hour ETH variance forecasts over clock-free dynamics and expanding mean variance.
mechanism: Recurring global trading-session participation produces an hour-of-day volatility clock.
primaryBaseline: Stronger of clock-free dynamic variance and expanding mean variance

evidence.summary: The clock increment was not significant and the candidate was materially worse than expanding mean variance under QLIKE.

nextAction: Keep this hourly ETH adaptation rejected; do not search alternate clock encodings on its opened holdout.
